title: Cubemap faces loaded from URLs get the env-atlas texture state and are decoded as RGBP instead of sRGB
expected_finding: the cubemap's faces are plain 8-bit sRGB images, but they are stored in a UNORM image with type 'rgbp', so fsSkybox applies decodeRGBP (rgb * (8 - 7a), squared) to sRGB code values instead of an sRGB decode
